mostWorthwhile.text: Correcting the misheard request was most worthwhile: it changed a software job into a cooling job and ultimately led to a compatible fan cartridge.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the corrected request to the interface and then to Moth felt somewhat procedural, although it made the evidence accessible.

surprise.text: Moth confidently turned train noise into a plausible but wrong request for a code-box repair.

arbitrary.text: I expected to add the model plate directly to the sourced request, but it first had to be connected to Moth. The compatibility feedback clarified the sequence, though it was not obvious beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the corrected cooling ticket helps the clinic and how the neighborhood challenges the faulty directory; the sign repair also gave the chapter a pleasing physical payoff.
